sources.entry: Atlas Cloud - AI API gateway with one API key for LLM, image, video and audio models, including an OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint. #paid #api #llm

summary.name: Atlas Cloud
summary.one_liner: Atlas Cloud is a paid multimodal AI API gateway that gives developers one API key and an OpenAI-compatible endpoint to call 400+ image, video, audio and chat/LLM models.
keywords: pay as you go ai api
use_cases: Calling video, image, audio and LLM models through a single API key
Replacing OpenAI SDK calls with a different model provider by changing base URL
Building AI video generation features with Seedance or Kling models
Generating images with GPT Image, Seedream or Nano Banana models
Running open-weight LLMs such as DeepSeek, Qwen or Kimi via one endpoint
summary.what_it_does: Atlas Cloud offers a single API for 400+ models across chat/LLM, image, video, audio and 3D, including Seedance, Seedream, GPT Image, Kling, DeepSeek and others. It provides OpenAI-compatible endpoints that the page says can be used as a drop-in replacement by changing the base URL and API key. The page lists streaming, batch processing, and structured outputs, plus one API key across its API, MCP server, CLI and skills. Models are priced per second (video) or per token (LLM) on a pay-as-you-go basis, with example rates shown on the page.
notable: One OpenAI-compatible API key covering LLM, image, video and audio models
Day-0 access to newly released models, per the page
Seedance 2.5 Flash listed at a limited-time 35% discount through Nov 30
Claims SOC 2 certification and HIPAA compliance
caveats: Pay-as-you-go pricing; the page does not state a free usage tier beyond a 'Sign Up for Free' prompt
Promotional 35% discount on Seedance 2.5 Flash is time-limited (ends Nov 30)
Private cloud and enterprise features require contacting sales
